body: Owner dry-run kit posted from this PR's head `b12db2f06` with "Sodick Wire EDM (LN2W)": https://github.com/mkinney/cam-tools-and-fixtures/tree/main/samples/edm-validation/sodick-ln2w-kit-2026-11-25 (square and 2-axis). Both start exactly as the owner gave it (G00 X Y / Z0. / T91 / T84 / T94 / C000 / U0. V0. / cut, no G21). The old Nov 21 taper test project is refused at post time by the wire undercut check (ConeHole, kerf 0.0123 mm off the part): a project/geometry matter, not this post; not in the kit.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b12db2f0680d1845f8b627a3f226cc367f217c36 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The vertical-cut goldens follow the owner's start sequence. The square program selects a new condition and flushing word for each skim. The Mark 21 script and its recorded programs have no changes.

Local results on upstream main `aef12fea67e0082e7ba835a3d9fcade8e2c11eb0` with PR head `b12db2f0680d1845f8b627a3f226cc367f217c36`. Main is already an ancestor of the PR head.

- Quick gate ran 868 steps in 61.4 minutes. It passed 867 steps. The UI library step had 1,677 passed, 7 failed, and 8 ignored. Six report tests gave `No adapter found`. The headless test gave `no graphics adapter`. The headless host has no usable GPU. The same command on bare main gave the same seven failures and errors.
- Clippy passed for all app and post targets with warnings denied.
- The light gate passed all six steps, including the build and all 11 light cases. The author reports one passing targeted heavy step in the PR body. I ran no heavy steps.
- I read the three NC goldens and 11 refusal goldens line by line. The PR body lists all 14. The golden checks passed.
- Both independent mutations failed their assertions. Removing `Z0.` failed the start-order assertion. Removing `G50` failed the taper-cancel assertion. The original script passed both before and after. These checks ran in memory with the script callbacks and synthetic records.

Extra suites run

- App. `example_catalog` 43 passed, 4 ignored. `example_catalog_adaptive` 1 passed. `example_catalog_edge_work` 1 passed. `conformance` 7 passed. `golden_cl` 34 passed. `recorded_post_streams` 5 passed. `wire_post` 29 passed. `sodick_wire_post` 8 passed. `feature_edge_g1_join` 5 passed.
- Post. `script_sodick_ln2w` 16 passed. `script_sodick_wire` 11 passed. `recorded_streams` 12 passed.
- Geometry. `step_csys_read` 11 passed. `step_edge_gap` 4 passed. `step_twisted_flank` 2 passed.
- Kernel. `step_agreement` 29 passed. `step_import` 3 passed. `step_closed_form` 3 passed. `step_edge_gap` 6 passed. `step_twisted_flank` 3 passed. `machining_mesh` 7 passed. `machining_mesh_bounds` 5 passed. `machining_mesh_parity` 7 passed. `machining_mesh_shortfalls` 3 passed, 1 ignored. `mesh_deviation_bench` 1 ignored. `solidcraft_hostile` 3 passed. `solidcraft_import` 8 passed.

Requested before merge

1. `assets/machines/sodick-aq600l.mch:11` — The profile permits 120 mm of travel on each taper axis. Sodick lists 80 mm on each axis for the AQ600L. The profile can accept a cut outside the published travel. Use the limits for the specified configuration. Check the guide and thickness limits for the 20-degree rating. Update the profile test, guide, and decision record. [Sodick AQ400L/AQ600L brochure, page 7](https://www.yumpu.com/en/document/view/11216937/download-this-publication-as-pdf-sodick/6)
2. `assets/machines/sodick-aq600l.mch:21` — The profile specifies mitre corners without evidence that the LN2W control cuts them. The post only writes the corner rule in a comment. A control that rounds the lower corner can cut a different surface from the one CamCraft checked. Confirm the corner motion and pin the matching rule, or refuse tapered cuts that depend on it.
3. `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:533` — The post maps positive stream angles directly to `G51`. The app reverses the stream sign when the machine specifies `top_right` at `crates/app/src/posting_wire.rs:393`. This is a valid machine setting, and the post accepts it. A left lean can become `G52`, which leans right. Refuse the incompatible side convention or use it to recover the intended side. Add a regression case. [Sodick LN1W/LN2W training manual, page 66](https://fab.cba.mit.edu/content/tools/sodick_edm/sodick_user_manual_small.pdf#page=66)
4. `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:306` — The post reads the fixture height from the machine profile for every setup. The shipped profile supplies zero. A 20 mm part on a 5 mm fixture can post `TP20.` and `TN0.`, although its planes are 25 mm and 5 mm above the table. Require an explicit height for the active setup, or refuse taper until the setup height can be supplied and checked. [Sodick LN1W/LN2W training manual, pages 68–72](https://fab.cba.mit.edu/content/tools/sodick_edm/sodick_user_manual_small.pdf#page=68)
5. `crates/kernel/tests/step_agreement.rs:36` — The bench reads STEP files only at the top of `testdata/models`. The three new files in `edm/` have no rows or registered cases. Add the rows and cases, and make the file-set test include their paths.

6. `assets/posts/sodick-ln2w.cps:533` — A nonzero angle below 0.0005 degree rounds to `A0.`. The script posts this as a taper and reports no error. I reproduced it with a 0.0004-degree stream. Refuse a nonzero taper that rounds to zero, or use verified precision that preserves it.

Optional

- `assets/posts/AGENTS.md:388` points to `crates/post/tests/sodick_ln2w.rs`. The test binary is `crates/post/tests/script_sodick_ln2w.rs`, and its pins are in `crates/post/tests/sodick_ln2w/pins.rs`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Owner correction after the round-2 dry-run kit (2026-11-25):** the U/V zero belongs **on the rapid to the start point**, not on its own line before the cut. Expected:

```
G54
G00 X-22. Y10. U0. V0.
Z0.
T91
T84
T94
C000
G01 X-25.838 Y10.
```

So: `G00 X.. Y.. U0. V0.` (one line), then `Z0.`, `T91`, `T84`, `T94`, `C…`, then the first cut. No separate `U0. V0.` line. This supersedes the order in the #4045 issue comment.

The owner's reason for `U0. V0.` on the rapid line: if the heads are left tapered, the control aligns them to thread the wire and, once threading is done, **moves them back to their old tapered position**. Zeroing U/V during the rapid (before `T91`) leaves them vertical after threading. Worth a header comment and a pin that U0. V0. is on the `G00` to the start point and before `T91`.

Addressed: the review of head `b12db2f06` and the owner's round-2 correction. The new head is `5bd7ff4dd` (commit `5bd7ff4dd`). The PR stays a draft.

Owner correction:

- Each cut now starts `G00 X.. Y.. U0. V0.`, `Z0.`, `T91`, `T84`, `T94`, `C...`, then the first cut. The separate `U0. V0.` line is removed. The header comment, `assets/posts/AGENTS.md`, the guide and the decision record state the new order.
- Pins: `the_start_sequence_is_the_owners_and_no_unit_word_is_written`, `the_ln2w_square_posts_its_golden_in_the_owners_start_order`, `the_ln2w_two_axis_block_posts_its_golden`.
- Goldens moved: `edm_test_square.nc` and `edm_test_2axis.nc`. Only the `G00` line and the removed `U0. V0.` line changed.

Findings:

1. U/V travel is 80 x 80 mm (+-40). The example guide span is 100 mm, so a 20 degree lean (36.4 mm) stays inside the travel. Pin: `the_aq600l_file_states_its_figures_and_names_the_ln2w_post`.
2. The machine file states no `edm.taper_angle`, so it claims no corner rule. The post refuses each tapered cut, so no cut depends on the corner motion. Pin: the same test.
3. The post writes no `G51` / `G52`. A taper on a `top_right` machine, with a positive or a negative angle, is refused by name. Pin: `every_taper_is_refused_by_name_and_writes_no_taper_word`.
4. `edm.table_to_part_bottom` and `PARAM WireBottom` are removed. The post writes no `TP` / `TN`. A taper waits for a setup height. Pins: `every_taper_is_refused_by_name_and_writes_no_taper_word`, `the_ln2w_taper_part_is_refused_by_name_until_its_heights_and_rules_are_confirmed`. The taper golden is removed.
5. `step_agreement` reads `testdata/models/edm/` and has three rows and three tests. A STEP subdirectory that no bench pins fails `step_files_agree_or_refuse_by_name`.
6. No `A` word is written. A 0.0004 degree taper is refused by name. Pin: `every_taper_is_refused_by_name_and_writes_no_taper_word`.
- Optional: `assets/posts/AGENTS.md` names `crates/post/tests/sodick_ln2w/pins.rs` and the binary `script_sodick_ln2w`.

Issue #4075 holds the work to post a taper again: a setup height, the confirmed corner motion, the lean side and the angle precision.

Evidence on `5bd7ff4dd`:

- Mutations: 8 of 8 red, all green after the restore. The PR body has the table.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 868 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled. The example catalog suites pass.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-kernel --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- `sodick-wire.cps` and the Mark 21 goldens have no diff.

Please review the new head again.
